title: Evaluation of a structured, guideline-based, multimodal care model for people with inflammatory skin diseases
summary:
The EsmeDerm project aims to improve the treatment of people with psoriasis (PSO) or neurodermatitis (atopic dermatitis). To achieve this, patients are cared for in specialized centers focusing on inflammatory skin diseases.
At these centers, an individualized treatment plan is first developed in accordance with current medical standards. In addition, patients receive comprehensive counseling on how to better manage their condition in everyday life and on factors that may influence or worsen their symptoms.
Through this structured approach to care, the aim is to reduce symptoms and sustainably improve patients’ quality of life over the long term.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Legal adulthood (age ≥ 18 years)
- Chronic inflammatory skin disease: PSO or  AD
- DLQI score of at least 6 points
- HADS score of at least 3 points
- Covered by statutory health insurance
- Access to a smartphone for installation of the study app and sufficient technical skills to complete registration successfully
Exclusion criteria:
Insufficient proficiency in spoken and written German
